name: Blue Hell
author: LaZye
description: Spam between the cube portal and spikes at 19% and then release shortly after your icon passes the cube portal to be able to play through the gameplay as the wave. Navigate through the levels gameplay as the wave from there while going above the dual portal at 29%, going above the ball portal at 39%, going above the dual cube portal at 42%, going under the UFO portal between the spike and portal at 55%. At 61%, you will enter a wave portal. Play the level normally from there.
